technology.summary:
Today's technology news includes a review of the Telo MT1, America's smallest electric truck, which is said to turn heads with its unique design. LG's RGB LED TV is also reviewed, with the verdict that it is good for certain situations, but an OLED is better.

In other news, Elon Musk has intensified his attack on Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani over the Starlink India launch delay, accusing him of blocking competition. Anthropic has cut off its internal evaluations from the live internet, citing an inability to reliably control its AI agents.

There is also a review of an AI bird feeder, a look at the brains of people on psychedelics, and a list of AI agents that can live in your text messages.

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes a landmark ruling by the Supreme Court of India, which highlighted steep markups on cancer drugs enforced by hospitals, causing a 5% drop in the BSE Hospitals Index. The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have joined forces to streamline regulatory procedures and facilitate foreign portfolio investors' entry into the market. Southeast Asian bonds are at risk of a selloff due to a resurgent El Niño pattern, while Indian equity benchmarks have declined due to profit booking and rising oil prices.

citations.headline: Hospital stocks slip after SC query on steep cancer drug markups
Sebi, RBI join hands to make onboarding easier for FPIs

politics.summary: Today's most important politics news includes the Delhi High Court's dismissal of pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. The Supreme Court is set to list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar, where protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Congress has condemned the detention of tribal students headed for a protest in Mumbai, and Jairam Ramesh has attacked the CEC for executing illegal orders. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has called the US electoral process 'corrupt', citing a non-existent Indian election, and India's foreign exchange reserves have dropped by $18.34 billion in a single week.
